bound: Each poll adds one scalar stamp read over visible cases and their input row identities/versions; full summaries read only changed cases plus at most 20 page cases, and the process cache retains only case IDs visible to its last completed answer (no input JSON bodies).
design: One SQL statement folds count, max primary key and ordered key/xmin digests per relation into each case stamp; xmin detects in-place changes without relying on application timestamp or revision discipline.

All 14 summary inputs are covered: cases, sources, building preparations, streamed profiles, intake items/parts/targets, packages, key profiles, coverage, evidence candidates/confirmations, intake confirmations and jobs. Package-linked targets are included even outside the case.

Cache entries hold stamp and nullable summary only; replace the map after each successful answer, retain a local snapshot across awaits, and clear on pool replacement. Waiting counts remain independent of q/status/page.

acceptance: First call summarizes all cases; unchanged repeat summarizes only page cases; all search/status filters keep waitingBatches=1 across separate pages.
Answering the case on page 3 changes waitingBatches from 1 to 0 on page 1; changing it back without updated_at also invalidates.
In-place updates of all 14 input relations, without changing keys/counts/application stamps, refresh exactly the affected off-page case.
Overlapping calls survive another answer evicting a previously cached case; legacy/prepared cases still return null summaries.
